hooks.command: DATA_DIR=~/.claude/plugins/data/meeting-simplifier-meeting-simplifier; mkdir -p "$DATA_DIR"; bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/cleanup_old_versions.sh" >>"$DATA_DIR/cleanup.log" 2>&1; if [ ! -f "$DATA_DIR/.setup-complete" ]; then MS_SETUP_MARKER="$DATA_DIR/.setup-complete" nohup bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/setup.sh" >"$DATA_DIR/setup.log" 2>&1 & fi

PID_DIR=/tmp/meeting-simplifier; if [ -f "$PID_DIR/rec.pid" ]; then P=$(cat "$PID_DIR/rec.pid" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$P" ]; then kill "$P" 2>/dev/null; for i in $(seq 1 10); do sleep 0.1; kill -0 "$P" 2>/dev/null || break; done; kill -0 "$P" 2>/dev/null && kill -9 "$P" 2>/dev/null; fi; rm -f "$PID_DIR/rec.pid" "$PID_DIR/audio_path"; fi
